items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, and he told me hey, you direct the show and let Mrs. Nicholas play and her husband would play the drums.

ctx.x: She's a superstar now. What about the Nicholas brothers when they were little babies.

The great movie start. One of our own, he just died not too long ago.
